verse.verse_1: Wax ku akhri Nabiyow Magaca Eebe ee abuuray (khaliqiga).
verse.verse_3: Akhri Eebana waa kan Sharafta lehe.
verse.verse_4: Ee Dadka baray sida Qalinka wax loogu qoro.
verse.verse_6: Saas ma aha ee Dadku (Gaaladu) waa gudbeen.
verse.verse_11: Bal ka warrama hadduu ka laga reebi hanuunsanyahay (waa Nabiga).
verse.verse_12: Ama uu fari Eeba ka yaabid.
verse.verse_13: Balse ka warrama hadduu midka wax ka reebi uu beeniyay (xaqa) kana jeedsaday (waa AbuuJahal iyo wixii la mid ahe).
verse.verse_15: Saas ma aha ee hadduusan joogin waxaannu qaban Foodda.
verse.verse_19: Saas ma aha ee warkiisa ha maqlin Sujuudna una dhawow (Eebe).
